faq.q: How is a titanium anode basket stiffener rib manufactured?
faq.a: A typical titanium anode basket stiffener rib is manufactured using Expanded mesh forming; TIG welding (ERTi-2); Sheet metal bending; CNC drilling. BOZE CNC Ti uses precision CNC equipment with strict process controls to ensure consistent quality and dimensional accuracy.

faq.q: What are the alternatives to Grade 2 CP-Ti for titanium anode basket stiffener rib?
faq.a: Alternative materials include stainless steel (heavier, susceptible to corrosion) and aluminum (lower strength, shorter fatigue life). The alternative manufacturing method is Laser welding (higher capital cost, limited wall thickness capability).

faq.q: What standards apply to titanium anode basket stiffener rib?
faq.a: Titanium Anode Basket Stiffener Rib components are typically manufactured to ASTM B348, ASME. Additional customer-specific specifications may apply.
